bluf: Wolfgang Digital is an employee owned performance agency in Ireland selling SEO, paid search, paid social, CRM automation and analytics to Irish and international brands and billing itself Europe's most awarded agency. It is folding GEO into SEO and publishing on ChatGPT Shopping, with six wins at the 2026 Global Search Awards on 2026-09-24, and the Horus read puts it Favored at 11.2, best placed for KJ1 and KJ2. A rival should know it practises 4 of 6 tested lines on its own house, runs 48 Google ads and 11 LinkedIn ads, sells AI visibility with no llms.txt, and shares no client with another tracked agency.
doing:
Wolfgang Digital positions as an employee owned Irish performance agency and growth partner to Irish and international brands in search, social and email: it owns itself and sells the channels an ecommerce brand buys. The headline claim is Ireland's and Europe's most awarded agency, six time Best Global Agency winner and Google's top EMEA performer. The record lists no founding year, employee count or office; its two BambooHR jobs (Account Manager, Junior Web Developer) are Dublin 2 posts.

The sold mix leads with two lines at score 3: Paid Search (Google Premier Partner; PMax, value based bidding and Very Ireland Shopping cases) and SEO (an alcohol D2C case claiming 925% revenue growth). Five lines score 2 as core: AI Search / GEO (GEO in the SEO page title, the Millies AI search case), Creator & Influencer (short form video, TikTok and SEOcial cases), Data & Measurement (GA4, predictive modelling, server side tracking cases), Email & CRM (email among three meta pillars; automation revenue cases) and Paid Social (Breast Cancer Ireland and offline conversion cases). Five more lines score 1 without evidence; local, retail media and web build score 0. Wolfgang Pulse and Wolfgang Signal, named on the Social Creative page, are the only proprietary items; their function is not shown.

Its AI posture folds GEO into SEO as AI innovator branding, with cases on AI automations and Shopping ads, and a 2026-07-22 piece saying it uses AI to understand audiences rather than mass produce content. Moves in date order: two 2025 awards surfaced through its own Google ads; a 2026-03-03 report putting Irish online retail growth at 19% year on year; 5 Global Social Media Awards on 2026-05-14; Best Large PPC Agency at the European Search Awards on 2026-05-21; six Global Search Awards wins on 2026-09-24. The record lists no pricing signals. Conspicuously absent: any retail media or web build line, and a headcount or office.
clients:
Client type is mixed; verticals are Retail & ecommerce, Travel & tourism, Hospitality, Health & wellness, Education, Software & services, Business services and Charity & nonprofit; the home market is Ireland.

The needs read holds 23 clients: 21 observed and 2 names only, from 5 dated case studies and 18 slugs; the mix leads with paid performance (N2, 10), organic demand (N1, 5) and CRM (N6, 5). Three rows (Right Hook Jab, Laced Up for, a second Elverys) are title fragments or duplicates. Very Ireland came for paid performance with AI and commerce codes: AI rewrote the rules for its Shopping ads. Millies came for AI search: Millies vs the Multinationals, Round Two in AI Search (2026-09-24) is the newest case. Elverys (Intersport Elverys) came for CRO (2021-11-23); Bodyslims for email and social (2021-11-25); the Laced Up for Success case (2023-12-08) claims a 500% revenue rise from email automation; WHILL for paid ads (2024-05-30). From slugs: Trend Micro for paid search; Breast Cancer Ireland for paid social; Maldron Hotels, The Digital Marketing Institute, Clario and Aura Leisure for SEO content; Woodie's and SOSU Cosmetics for social; McCabes for social and email; Petstop and The Sweater Shop for CRO; Arctic Adventures for digital PR; HomeSecure for social leads.

Names only, need inferred from the sold mix: Littlewoods Ireland (a YouTube strategy slug, no described work) and Innopharma. No client is shared with another tracked agency.

What the base needs next, tied to KJ1 (citation replaces click) and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers): it is likely, moderate confidence, that these Irish ecommerce clients ask for AI search visibility and ChatGPT Shopping next, its blog subjects on 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-22, and roughly even, low confidence, that they buy a measured citation number rather than a GEO line folded into SEO.
house: Say and do: 6 lines tested, 4 practised, integrity 66.7. Paid search is corroborated by its own Google ads, 48 in the Transparency Center and 14 in the last 30 days, last shown 2026-09-27; a sample reads 'Winners Of Best Use Of Paid Social At Global Social Media Awards 2025. Contact Us Today!'. LinkedIn advertising is corroborated: 11 ads, 8 company and 3 thought leader posts. Creator work is corroborated by its own Instagram and YouTube channels. AI Search / GEO is contradicted: it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt. Paid social is contradicted: no social ad pixel. Publishing cadence reads 2 of 120 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 10 in 365, yet the own site read counted 569 sitemap URLs and six blog posts dated 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-22: the two reads disagree. The tag stack is GTM alone; no CMS, test tool, pixel or ABM stack detected; no AI crawler blocked.
market:
The Horus read puts Wolfgang Digital at a tailwind index of 11.2, band Favored, percentile 48, 16:38 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ1 (the click replaced by the citation), driven by AI Search / GEO and Paid Search, SEO pulling against, and KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) on the same lines. Most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out), driven by Paid Search, SEO and Paid Social, and KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two) through Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV. Best fit: The Walled Oasis at 36/100. Making P2 and P4, partial on P1 and P7, absent on P6 and P8; P3 not applicable, P5 unknown.

The Monsoon read is 50.2, band Breeze, percentile 29: migration 48.7 against displacement 51.7. Its sold mix supplies 49 of the index, SEO (13) and Paid Search (9) carrying most movable hours; work goes 65% to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb, automation overlapping 25% of it. Footprint inferred: no hub office, no onshore claim.
openings:
The strongest judgment is the AI visibility contradiction: Wolfgang Digital folds GEO into its SEO page, publishes on ChatGPT Shopping, yet its own site has no llms.txt and no audited AI visibility product shows in the record (P1 partial). A rival that publishes a citation share number for an Irish retailer very likely (moderate confidence) beats a GEO line folded into SEO. Falsifier: an llms.txt on wolfgangdigital.com or a scorecard with named client citation figures closes it.

KJ6 removes hours from its Paid Search, SEO and Paid Social lines, and displacement at 51.7 on the Monsoon read makes a price led pitch a roughly even chance (low confidence). It runs paid search with no sign of ads tested inside AI assistants (P8 absent): the first Irish rival with holdout results there sets the price. No public pricing model (P5 unknown) leaves an outcome priced offer unanswered. The contestable accounts are the slug only names whose work is a single line, Trend Micro, Maldron Hotels, Clario, Aura Leisure and Petstop, where a dated case with a number outweighs a slug. The paid social contradiction (no social pixel on its own site) is a pitch question against its 2025 paid social award.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and the KJ1 tailwind behind its Favored band.
I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1.

I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would say whether the ChatGPT Shopping demand it blogs about becomes a channel it can sell (KJ2) while its P8 stays absent.

I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, October 2026: output or outcome pricing at a top five holdco would press the KJ6 middle it sits in with no public pricing of its own.

The 2026-09-17 post on changing how it measures SEO from traffic to visibility: whether the next deepen pass shows a named client visibility figure tells whether GEO becomes a product or stays a page title.
